# Elite Irrigation & Landscaping

Elite Irrigation & Landscaping provides award-winning outdoor property services including irrigation, drainage, hardscaping, and outdoor lighting for the greater Charlotte, North Carolina area (Harrisburg, Concord, Huntersville). 

## About Us
We are a highly professional, licensed, and insured local business focusing on high-end residential and commercial outdoor solutions. We offer photo-documented service, fast response times, and frictionless booking. 

## Services
- Landscape Design and Installation
- Irrigation and Water Management Services
- Irrigation Systems
- Lawn Care and Maintenance
- Tree and Shrub Care Services
- Weed and Pest Control Treatments
- Patio Installs
- Retaining Walls
- Drainage Fixes
- Irrigation
- Landscaping
- Drainage
- Hardscapes
- Outdoor Lighting
- Commercial Grounds
- Seasonal Cleanup
- Snow & Ice Removal
- Christmas Lighting
- Sod / Grading
- Property Maintenance
